title: A Boat for Aldous
description: Provost Agathe Lorn holds to the order's word: the Firstflame failed. But if Aldous Wren saw something, he can come to Kindleby and say it to the chapter, and she would send a boat for him.

stages.text: The Provost would send a boat for Brother Aldous, if he'll come to Kindleby and say to the chapter what he saw. Tell him so; he's on his bench by Saltmarrow harbor.
Aldous won't get in a boat to be weighed by a chapter. He wrote it down instead, on the back of a tide-table. Carry his letter to the Provost on Kindleby.
